speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To begin narrowing down the cause, have you noticed any jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes) or dark urine recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). 

The patient is a 32-year-old female with a classic presentation of fatigue and severe pruritus, but her history of ulcerative colitis and inconsistent condom use with multiple female partners raises suspicion for Hepatitis C or other sexually transmitted viral hepatitis. I need to confirm if she has ever noticed yellowing of the skin or eyes, and I will request a test to differentiate between autoimmune cholestatic liver disease and viral causes.

REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel (including ALP, GGT, Bilirubin, ALT, AST, and AMA)
REQUEST TEST: HCV_Antigen_and_Antibody
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound
